notes: v610 — ONE COMPACT PILL INSTEAD OF FIVE BUTTONS. Tony's own second thought, and the right call: five always-visible floor buttons on the radar risked exactly the clutter he's pushed back on all night, especially on phone. Replaced with a single pill showing your current floor — tap it and the other four drop down underneath; pick one and it closes again. Same footprint every time, no matter how many options exist. Same underlying choices and instant setter as before — only how they're shown changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
